definitions.gloss: counter for buildings; building (in a complex)
definitions.explanation: Counts large buildings such as apartment blocks, hospital wings and warehouses. After a letter or number it names one building of a complex: A{棟|とう}, {東|ひがし}{棟|とう}.

examples.japanese: ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧3{棟|とう}⟦{建|た}っている→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧。
⟦{会議室|かいぎしつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧B{棟|とう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧2⟦{階|かい}→階：01034_kai⟧です。
examples.english: The meeting room is on the second floor of Building B.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧5{棟|とう}⟦{焼|や}けた→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}っていた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The news said five houses burned down in the fire.

notes:
COUNTING PATTERNS:
1{棟|とう} (いっとう), 2{棟|とう} (にとう), 3{棟|とう} (さんとう), 6{棟|とう} (ろくとう), 8{棟|とう} (はっとう), 10{棟|とう} (じゅっとう)

USAGE:
{棟|とう} is the word used in news reports, real-estate listings and on signs. In everyday talk, ordinary houses are usually counted with ⟦{軒|けん}→〜軒：01993_ken⟧ (⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧3⟦{軒|けん}→〜軒：01993_ken⟧), and buildings in general with つ or ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{病棟|びょうとう}→病棟：21002_byoutou⟧: hospital ward or wing
- {研究棟|けんきゅうとう}: research building
- ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧○{棟|とう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全焼|ぜんしょう}→全焼：17094_zenshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: ○ houses burn down completely (news)
